<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="150%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="2" stdDeviation="3" flood-color="#DCDCDC" flood-opacity="0.8"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#F3F2F7"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="28" fill="#110053"/>
  <text x="20" y="19" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="12px" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">9:41</text>
  <rect x="326" y="11" width="3" height="7" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <rect x="331" y="9" width="3" height="9" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <rect x="336" y="7" width="3" height="11" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <rect x="342" y="5" width="3" height="13" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="355" cy="12" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="358" y1="15" x2="361" y2="18" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="367" y="7" width="17" height="11" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="369" y="9" width="12" height="7" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <rect x="384" y="10" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- Header -->
  <rect x="0" y="28" width="390" height="78" fill="#110053"/>
  <g>
    <polyline points="34,67 25,76 34,85" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <line x1="26" y1="76" x2="47" y2="76" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  </g>
  <text x="61" y="70" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="19px" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">Acompañante frecuente</text>
  <text x="61" y="90" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="12px" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF">Datos del pasajero</text>

  <!-- Main content card -->
  <rect x="14" y="120" width="362" height="647" rx="7" fill="#DCDCDC" opacity="0.5"/>
  <rect x="14" y="118" width="362" height="647" rx="7" fill="#FFFFFF" filter="url(#shadow)"/>

  <text x="30" y="148" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="19px" font-weight="700" fill="#110053">Información personal</text>
  <text x="30" y="170" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="13px" font-weight="400" fill="#5C5C5C">Completa los datos tal como aparecen en el documento.</text>

  <!-- Name fields -->
  <text x="30" y="198" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="13px" font-weight="700" fill="#1C1B1F">Nombre</text>
  <rect x="30" y="204" width="160" height="49" rx="7" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#B6B6B6" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="43" y="234" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="15px" font-weight="400" fill="#1C1B1F">Valentina</text>

  <text x="202" y="198" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="13px" font-weight="700" fill="#1C1B1F">Apellido</text>
  <rect x="202" y="204" width="160" height="49" rx="7" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#B6B6B6" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="215" y="234" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="15px" font-weight="400" fill="#1C1B1F">Rojas</text>

  <!-- Gender -->
  <text x="30" y="278" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="13px" font-weight="700" fill="#1C1B1F">Género</text>
  <rect x="30" y="284" width="332" height="49" rx="7" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#B6B6B6" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="43" y="314" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="15px" font-weight="400" fill="#1C1B1F">Femenino</text>
  <polyline points="337,304 343,310 349,304" fill="none" stroke="#110053" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>

  <!-- Birth date -->
  <text x="30" y="358" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="13px" font-weight="700" fill="#1C1B1F">Fecha de nacimiento</text>
  <rect x="30" y="364" width="332" height="49" rx="7" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#B6B6B6" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="43" y="394" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="15px" font-weight="400" fill="#1C1B1F">14 de septiembre de 1992</text>
  <rect x="331" y="378" width="15" height="14" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#110053" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="331" y1="383" x2="346" y2="383" stroke="#110053" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="335" y1="375" x2="335" y2="381" stroke="#110053" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="342" y1="375" x2="342" y2="381" stroke="#110053" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <line x1="30" y1="435" x2="360" y2="435" stroke="#E0E0E2" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="30" y="463" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="19px" font-weight="700" fill="#110053">Documento de viaje</text>
  <text x="30" y="484" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="13px" font-weight="400" fill="#5C5C5C">Necesario para gestionar tu reserva.</text>

  <!-- Document type and number -->
  <text x="30" y="512" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="13px" font-weight="700" fill="#1C1B1F">Tipo de documento</text>
  <rect x="30" y="518" width="142" height="49" rx="7" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#B6B6B6" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="43" y="548" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="15px" font-weight="400" fill="#1C1B1F">Pasaporte</text>
  <polyline points="149,538 155,544 161,538" fill="none" stroke="#110053" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>

  <text x="184" y="512" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="13px" font-weight="700" fill="#1C1B1F">Número</text>
  <rect x="184" y="518" width="178" height="49" rx="7" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#B6B6B6" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="197" y="548" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="15px" font-weight="400" fill="#1C1B1F">PA7842316</text>

  <!-- Nationality -->
  <text x="30" y="592" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="13px" font-weight="700" fill="#1C1B1F">Nacionalidad</text>
  <rect x="30" y="598" width="332" height="49" rx="7" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#B6B6B6" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="43" y="628" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="15px" font-weight="400" fill="#1C1B1F">Chilena</text>
  <polyline points="337,618 343,624 349,618" fill="none" stroke="#110053" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>

  <!-- Terms checkbox -->
  <rect x="30" y="668" width="18" height="18" rx="3" fill="#9747FF" stroke="#9747FF" stroke-width="1"/>
  <polyline points="34,677 38,681 45,673" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <text x="58" y="681" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="13px" font-weight="400" fill="#1C1B1F">Guardar como acompañante frecuente</text>
  <text x="30" y="706" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="11px" font-weight="400" fill="#5C5C5C">Podrás editar esta información más adelante.</text>

  <!-- Save button -->
  <g>
    <rect x="30" y="718" width="332" height="43" rx="7" fill="#EA104C"/>
    <text x="196" y="745" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="15px" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">Guardar acompañante</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <rect x="0" y="780" width="390" height="64" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="780" x2="390" y2="780" stroke="#E0E0E2" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- Inicio -->
  <g>
    <polygon points="39,800 49,792 59,800" fill="none" stroke="#5C5C5C" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <rect x="42" y="799" width="14" height="12" rx="1" fill="none" stroke="#5C5C5C" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <text x="49" y="832" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="10px" font-weight="400" fill="#5C5C5C">Inicio</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Viajes -->
  <g>
    <rect x="112" y="795" width="19" height="14" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#5C5C5C" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <line x1="116" y1="795" x2="116" y2="792" stroke="#5C5C5C" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <line x1="127" y1="795" x2="127" y2="792" stroke="#5C5C5C" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <line x1="112" y1="800" x2="131" y2="800" stroke="#5C5C5C" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="121" y="832" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="10px" font-weight="400" fill="#5C5C5C">Viajes</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Buscar -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="195" cy="800" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#5C5C5C" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <line x1="201" y1="806" x2="207" y2="812" stroke="#5C5C5C" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="195" y="832" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="10px" font-weight="400" fill="#5C5C5C">Buscar</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Ayuda -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="268" cy="800" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#5C5C5C" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <text x="268" y="805" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="13px" font-weight="700" fill="#5C5C5C">?</text>
    <text x="268" y="832" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="10px" font-weight="400" fill="#5C5C5C">Ayuda</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Perfil selected -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="341" cy="796" r="5" fill="#9747FF"/>
    <ellipse cx="341" cy="807" rx="10" ry="6" fill="none" stroke="#9747FF" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <text x="341" y="832" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="10px" font-weight="700" fill="#9747FF">Perfil</text>
  </g>
</svg>
